fullDescription: HIGHLIGHTSEstablished 201385% Residential / 15% Commercial Revenue MixOwner-Operated, 40 Hours/WeekExclusive Franchise TerritoryThis franchise resale opportunity offers a service-based operation with over a decade of established history. Founded in 2013, the business operates within a defined and protected territory as part of a recognized franchise system, providing structured processes and brand support.The revenue mix is primarily residential, accounting for approximately 85% of total work performed, with the remaining 15% coming from commercial projects. The business is currently owner-operated, with responsibilities including sales, scheduling, and customer communication, all managed within a standard 40-hour workweek.The franchise model provides access to an established brand presence, proven operating systems, and ongoing corporate support. This includes marketing resources, lead generation channels, and standardized workflows that reduce the need for trial-and-error typically associated with independent startups. The recognized brand and national presence can help drive customer trust, streamline customer acquisition, and support consistent service delivery.This opportunity is suited for a buyer seeking to step into an existing operation with an established customer base and defined territory. The structure allows for continued owner-operation or potential expansion through additional staffing and increased job volume within the territory.Disclaimer:Unbroker LLC does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information provided in this listing, as it is supplied directly by the seller. Prospective buyers are strongly encouraged to conduct their own due diligence. Any real estate represented as part of this transaction is sold directly by the business or property owner and not by Unbroker LLC.Ref: C041321
reasonForSelling: Owner is selling due to a planned retirement.
supportTraining: Seller will provide training on daily operations, customer management, scheduling, and use of franchise systems. Ongoing franchisor support includes marketing resources, operational guidance, and established processes to assist with a smooth transition and continued operations.
franchise: This business is an established franchise
facilities: The business operates as a mobile, service-based model within an exclusive territory and does not require a leased storefront or fixed commercial space. No significant equipment or inventory is included in the sale. As part of a franchise system, it benefits from established brand recognition, powerful marketing channels that support customer acquisition, and scheduling via a 24-hour national call center as well as online scheduling support. The asset-light structure allows for low overhead and operational flexibility within the defined service area.
growthExpansion: Growth opportunities include increasing job volume within the existing exclusive territory through expanded marketing efforts and lead conversion. A new owner could add field staff to take on additional projects and reduce owner involvement in job execution. Expanding commercial client outreach beyond the current 15% mix and leveraging franchisor marketing tools may also support increased revenue within the defined service area. Previous years, as recent as 2024, saw higher SDE and there is no reason those numbers could not return under new motivated ownership.
competition: The business operates within the residential and light commercial services sector, with approximately 85% of work derived from residential customers. As part of a franchise system, it benefits from established brand recognition, powerful marketing channels that support customer acquisition, and scheduling via a 24-hour national call center as well as online scheduling support. The defined exclusive territory limits direct internal competition, while demand is driven by ongoing property maintenance and improvement needs across both residential and commercial segments.
